meta.note: descriptive: margins are the tag minus the reference (positive: the reference costs less; a missing run is a loss for the reference); no p-values (D4)

identity.rule: r0 of each E7b rerun equal as a float to the frozen run of the same cell

R1.claim: some X = B(t) cap lands above the bound with a positive run-time excess in a stress or rho = 16 run, while no Sublet run does

R2.claim: median r0 of CR-cap-0 under the stress modes >= 0.95 while Sublet's <= 0.79

R3.claim: every cell where a cap's r0 is below Sublet's
